import warnings; warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')
import util, SVM, BoostedTree, NeuralNetwork
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = util.data_load('Mobile_Prices.csv', 'price_range', scalar=1)
X_train, y_train = X_train.iloc[:300], y_train.iloc[:300]
X_test, y_test = X_test.iloc[:150], y_test.iloc[:150]

print('svm params:', SVM.train_svm('Mobile_Prices.csv', X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test,
      pSVM={'C':10,'gamma':0.01,'kernel':'rbf','probability':True,'random_state':1}))
print('svm grid:', SVM.train_svm('Mobile_Prices.csv', X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test, 'rbf', numFolds=3))
print('btree params:', BoostedTree.train_BTree('Mobile_Prices.csv', X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test,
      pBTree={'base_estimator__max_depth':3,'n_estimators':50,'learning_rate':1.0,'random_state':1}))
print('btree grid:', BoostedTree.train_BTree('Mobile_Prices.csv', X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test, numFolds=3))
print('nn params:', NeuralNetwork.train_NN('Mobile_Prices.csv', X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test, 'adam',
      pNN={'hidden_layer_sizes':(64,64),'max_iter':1000,'random_state':1}))
print('nn grid:', NeuralNetwork.train_NN('Mobile_Prices.csv', X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test, 'adam', numFolds=2))
